questions.question: What term describes explanatory text attached to a cell?
questions.explanation: Explanatory text attached to a cell is a comment (Insert > Comment), shown with a red triangle indicator. A callout is a drawing shape.

questions.question: In OOP, what is method overloading?

options.C: Defining multiple methods with the same name but different parameters
options.D: Inheriting multiple methods from a parent class

questions.explanation: Method overloading is defining multiple methods with the same name but different parameter lists in the same class. Inheriting methods relates to inheritance/overriding.

questions.question: Which of the following is a service for real-time text communication on the internet ?
questions.explanation: Chat (instant messaging) is the internet service for real-time text communication. Video conferencing is real-time but audio/video based, and FTP transfers files.

questions.question: The OSI model consists of how many layers?
questions.explanation: The OSI reference model has 7 layers: Physical, Data Link, Network, Transport, Session, Presentation and Application. The TCP/IP model is usually given 4 or 5 layers.

questions.question: What is the term used when you press and hold the left mouse key and move the mouse around the slide?
questions.explanation: Pressing and holding the left mouse button while moving the mouse is called dragging.

questions.question: The presence of ________ makes a card smart?
questions.explanation: A smart card has an embedded microchip (processor and memory), which makes it 'smart'. A magnetic-stripe card only stores data and has no chip.

questions.question: Which of the following device provides the necessary translation of data received from network into a format or protocol recognized by devices with the internal network?
questions.explanation: A gateway connects networks using different protocols and translates data into a format the internal network understands. Routers and bridges forward data but do not perform protocol translation.

questions.question: The applications of AI include:
questions.explanation: Gaming, expert systems and machine/deep learning are all application areas of AI.

questions.question: Musa's Basic Model is used for measuring:
questions.explanation: Musa's basic execution time model is a software reliability growth model that predicts failure intensity over execution time. It does not measure size or complexity.

questions.question: Which of the following statements is correct about the class?

options.A: An object is an instance of its class.
options.B: A class is an instance of its object.
options.C: An object is the instance of the data type of that class.
options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: An object is an instance of its class; the class is the blueprint. Saying a class is an instance of its object reverses the relationship.

questions.question: How is the width of the data bus typically measured in a microcomputer system?
questions.explanation: Data bus width is the number of parallel lines, expressed in bits (e.g. 8, 16, 32, 64 bits). MHz measures clock speed and address lines describe the address bus.

questions.question: Which of the following is not a valid zoom percentage in Excel?
questions.explanation: Excel's zoom range is 10% to 400%, so 500% is not valid; 10, 100 and 300 are within range.

questions.question: What causes thrashing to occur?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Thrashing occurs when processes do not have enough frames, so the system spends most of its time paging (excessive page faults and swapping) instead of executing.

questions.question: What is the purpose of Domain Name System Server in networking?

options.B: To convert domain names into IP addresses
options.D: To establish a secure connection between devices.

questions.explanation: DNS translates human-readable domain names into IP addresses. Encryption and secure connections are handled by protocols such as TLS.

questions.question: Which one of the following is not a type of queue?
questions.explanation: Linear queue, circular queue and double-ended queue (deque) are all types of queue, so none of the options is the answer.

questions.question: Which language does a browser use to display information from the World Wide Web?
questions.explanation: A browser renders web pages written in HTML (a markup language), which is not among options A-C, so 'None of the above' is correct.

questions.question: A priority encoder is used to:

options.A: Convert binary information into a more compact form
options.B: Assign priority to input lines based on their values
options.D: Combine multiple input signals into a single output

questions.explanation: A priority encoder assigns priorities to its inputs and outputs the binary code of the highest-priority active input when several are active. Comparing numbers is done by a comparator; combining signals into one output is a multiplexer.

questions.question: The ability to query data, as well as insert, delete, and alter tuples, is offered by ________.
questions.explanation: DML (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) is used to query data and insert, delete and modify tuples. DDL defines schema, DCL manages permissions and TCL manages transactions.

questions.concept: Protocols and algorithms for IoT resources
questions.question: Resource management in IoT can be done by implementing ________.
questions.explanation: IoT resource management (energy, bandwidth, scheduling) is achieved by implementing suitable protocols together with algorithms, so the combined option is correct.

questions.question: What does the control unit generate to control other units?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: The control unit generates control signals that direct the operation of the ALU, memory and I/O units.

questions.question: Which shortcut key is used to compile and run the program in C++?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: In Turbo C++, Ctrl+F9 compiles and runs the program. Alt+F9 only compiles, and Alt+F5 shows the output screen.

questions.question: Which one is not an encryption Technique?
questions.explanation: AES, DES and RSA are encryption algorithms; FTP is a file transfer protocol.

questions.question: The "producer-consumer problem" is a classic synchronization problem that involves:

options.A: Two processes competing for the same resources
options.B: Two processes exchanging data through shared buffers
options.C: Two processes competing for CPU time
options.D: Two processes communicating over a network

questions.explanation: In the producer-consumer (bounded buffer) problem, a producer puts items into a shared buffer and a consumer removes them, requiring synchronization so they do not overflow or underflow the buffer.

questions.question: The difference between Slide Design and Auto Content Wizard is

options.B: Auto Content Wizard is just the wizard version of Slide Design
options.C: Slide Design does not provide sample content but Auto Content Wizard provides sample content too
options.D: Slide Design asks your choice in steps but Auto Content Wizard does not let you make choices

questions.explanation: Slide Design only applies a visual design, while the AutoContent Wizard also provides sample content (suggested text) for the chosen presentation type.

questions.question: Which software life cycle model allows for iterative development and incorporates risk analysis?
questions.explanation: Boehm's spiral model is iterative and adds explicit risk analysis in every loop. Waterfall is linear and Agile, though iterative, has no formal risk-analysis phase.
